resources.string: Tips are on the Play Store version

Quick start
 1. Install Torque Pro (the paid version; Torque Lite does not support plugins) and pair your OBD-II adapter.
 2. Enable this plugin in Torque → Settings → Plugins.
 3. Allow notifications, and set battery use to Unrestricted so Torque can start this plugin in the background.
 4. In Torque, select the vehicle profile for the car you are driving. Data is kept per Torque profile and checked against the vehicle's VIN/ECU identity.
 5. On a new profile the fuel source is detected when you connect; if asked, compare it with your dash gauge and tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. You can also pick it below.
 6. Tank size is the starting size for the Chunk fit until it learns its own. The plugin never changes it; each fit's learned size is shown below it.
 7. In Torque, add gauges for [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level and each fit's Corrected %, Remaining, DTE and Tank size. DTE is Remaining times Torque's long-term mpg. A notice during a refit says that fit reads 1:1 until its refit finishes.
 8. Feed fuel level back to Torque: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit onto your 012F gauge.
 9. Fuel is counted only while the engine runs. The plugin runs only while Torque is connected to the ECU.
 10. Keep driving and filling up; accuracy builds over several partial tanks. If a Wrong vehicle profile? notification appears, choose what to do with that drive.
 11. All data stays on this phone. No GPS or location is recorded.

Battery/background start was denied. Open once so the plugin can run with Torque.

Add additional tanks as needed (stock tank 1 always stays). Do not switch senders onto the PCM FLI pin (false fill). Each extra tank needs its own Torque extra PID (MCU Mode 22, unique name — not 012F or Ford 16C1). Select-PID value is the 1-based tank id. Gal/hr is charged only to the active tank.
Tank size is the starting size for the Chunk fit until it learns its own. The plugin never changes it; each fit\'s learned size is shown below it.

Writes a value onto Torque\'s stock Fuel Level (012F) so existing gauges show it: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit. A fit that is not built yet writes the smoothed level.
Requires Torque Pro (paid). Torque Lite does not support plugins.
The name of this vehicle profile. Each Torque vehicle profile gets its own plugin profile, data and learned maps.
Vehicle make (e.g. Ford). Used only to choose which brand-specific fuel PIDs detection may try.

Where the raw fuel level comes from. Detect (needs the ECU connected) tries the candidates read-only and asks you to confirm unless two sources agree. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. None = detect on the next connect.
Only for the source \"Torque extra PID by long name\": the exact long name of the Torque PID that reports the level.
blank = no starting size; each fit learns its own.
Time constant of the smoothing filter (0 = no smoothing).
Largest change per second the smoothed level may follow; slosh beyond this is ignored.
Rise in level while stopped that counts as a fill.
Optional: enter the odometer reading and Save pin to anchor distance for this profile.
Which tank the fuel burn (gal/hr) is charged to. From PID: a Torque PID chooses it (1-based tank id).
Only when Active tank = From PID: the long name of the Torque PID whose value is the tank id.
